title: Target-Fixed Physical Role Necessity for the Realized Neutrino Oscillation Interface
description: Identifies the physical response and interaction–propagation nonalignment required by the fixed oscillation interface before selecting its microscopic carrier.

title: Complete Physical Interface of the Neutrino Propagation Role Complex
description: Assembles the complete propagation interface, retaining active responses, source and detector attachments, and the shared physical witnesses needed for joint compatibility.

title: Source-First Exhaustion of the Physical Carrier Universe
description: Constructs a source-first universe of active carrier architectures before physical viability is assessed, retaining composition, matching and boundary structure.

title: Simultaneous Physical Constraint Collapse of the Neutrino Carrier Universe
description: Applies physical consistency requirements to one common realization, keeping their shared parameters and cross-sector conditions together.

title: Compatible Role-Occupancy Closure for the Neutrino Propagation Role Complex
description: Establishes compatible occupancy of the required neutrino role while retaining physically distinct carrier alternatives allowed by the oscillation target.

title: Standing-Carrier Upper Closure for the Neutrino Propagation Role Complex
description: Characterizes standing identity through seven retained response channels and exhibits four distinct ways that complete source contributions can survive or fail deletion.

title: Exact Standing-Carrier Stratification of the Neutrino Oscillation Realization Space
description: Constructs the exact symbolic standing atlas for the fixed oscillation target, including a continuum of different heavy thresholds with the same low-energy response.

title: Functorial Target Extension of Standing-Carrier Quotients
role: How new targets refine the space
description: Explains how additional physical targets can eliminate, preserve or split existing standing classes, while retaining distinctions already established at the original target.

title: Direct Kinematic-Mass Target Extension of the Neutrino Standing-Carrier Space
description: Adds beta-endpoint mass response to the standing-carrier space and separates the added absolute-support information from the original oscillation distinctions.

title: Lepton-Number-Violating Target Extension of the Neutrino Standing-Carrier Space
description: Adds lepton-number-violating transition amplitudes, distinguishing accepted zero and nonzero responses without treating a null search as a unique carrier selector.

title: Heavy-State Active Closure and CLFV Extension of the Neutrino Standing-Carrier Space
description: Adds heavy-state, active-closure and charged-lepton-flavor constraints, with an explicit benchmark family and a declared source comparison scope.

title: Successor Target for Quantitative Active Closure in the Neutrino Standing-Carrier Space
description: Defines a separate quantitative successor target with retained active-event response, preserving the distinction between new target information and the earlier heavy-state branch.

title: Cosmological Population and Transport Extension of the Neutrino Standing-Carrier Space
description: Adds cosmological population and transport information, separating the public-summary target from the complete correlated cosmological likelihood still required for the broader inference.

title: Symmetry and Charge Extensions of the Neutrino Standing-Carrier Space
description: Separates seven symmetry and charge targets, retaining their source, matching, anomaly and remnant conditions instead of treating symmetry labels as interchangeable.

title: Joint Standing-Carrier Closure for the Neutrino Sector
description: Combines the extended targets at one physical source and completes joint closure for two qualified vectorlike branches, while preserving unresolved parent branches and multiple realizations.

title: Physical Nature and Minimal Identity of the Neutrino Carrier
description: Identifies one complete terminal carrier within each accepted realization of the two qualified branches, with three light sectors and one rank-three heavy sector in the exact symmetric limit.

title: Observable Projection and Experimental Prediction Lock for the Neutrino Carrier
description: Derives the matched light charged-current deficit and inclusive heavy weight in the qualified branches, with a shared flavor structure and a prospective experimental protocol.

title: Structural Stability and Degeneracy Lifting of the Neutrino Heavy Sector
description: Separates the robustness of carrier identity, rank, closure, degeneracy and flavor equality, and specifies the response and resolution requirements for experimental inference.

title: A Neutrino Carrier Prediction: Robustness and a Framework for Experimental Testing
description: Combines the source-qualified carrier prediction and its robustness results into a framework for experimental testing, with numerical physical pole, lifetime and detector qualification still open.
